CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

April 9, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Absent:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER

Staff Present:
ERIC D. MARTINEZ

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: March 26, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the March 26, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  1
 D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  1625 South Campbell Avenue, DRB-2023-00216

  •  Request: This is an application for one (1) door replacement, ten (10) window
  replacements, and front covered patio remodel on an existing single-family
  dwelling unit.
  •  Applicant: Christian Velasquez
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Tsai makes a motion to approve the application without conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  2200 South Fremont Avenue, DRB-2024-00018

  •  Request: This is an application for one (1) new tenant sign for Unison Health
  Services, Inc. on an existing 2-story office building facing South Fremont Avenue.
  •  Applicant: Bob Packham - Absent
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following conditions:
  1. The applicant shall revise the plans so that the sign height does not exceed 30
  feet.
  2. The applicant must re-submit a revised set of plans for the project planner to
  verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following conditions:
  1) The applicant shall revise the location of the sign to be below the adjacent
  parapet height, centered between the horizontal band and the window opening,
  so that the sign height does not exceed 30 feet, as required by Planning.
  2) Should the applicant decide to appeal and request the sign to be higher than
  the 30 feet limit, then the applicant must submit a request for modification for
  the height with the planning department to obtain discretionary approval.
  Should the planning department accept the higher sign, and if the sign is in the
  same location as shown in this submittal, then the application does not need
  to come back to the Design Review Board again.
  3) The applicant must re-submit a revised set of plans for the City Architect and
  project planner to verify and approve; or comply with Condition #2.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.

  2
   •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 4:  69 East Main Street, DRB-2024-00026

  • Request: This is an application for three (3) new exterior tenant signs for Dollar
  Tree on an existing 1-story commercial building.
  • Applicant: Steven Schechter
  • Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following conditions:
  1. The applicant shall revise the description for the location of ‘Register
  Mark’ to be attached to the bottom right corner of letter “E” and provide
  typical dimensions.
  2. The applicant must re-submit a revised set of plans for City Architect to
  verify and approve.
MOTION:

  •  Board member Tsai makes a motion to approve the application with the following
  conditions:
  1) The applicant shall revise the description for the location of ‘Register Mark’ to
  be attached to the bottom right corner of letter “E” and provide typical
  dimensions.
  2) The applicant must re-submit a revised set of plans for City Architect to verify
  and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  3
 E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:40 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on April 23, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:40 P.M.
  •  The second was by Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger,
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Udani, Ng
